name: Oribe Kaori
source:
Occupation: Cook
Stay as: Dweller

A resident of the village of Fujiyoshi, Kaori is in charge of the dining hall in Yasumizu.

She is a calm person but can be rather strict with her children, Yasunaga and Yoshitsugu.

[Taken from the official art book included with the [url=/r65525]Day One Edition[/url].]
